headline: Set public hearing for Special Permit #206-26 at 4 Linden Ave and named Michael Vigorito to Community Preservation Committee.
summary: The board set a public hearing date for Special Permit #206-26 at 4 Linden Ave, requested by Bruce D. and April K. MacPhail, for September 15, 2026. The board also nominated Michael Vigorito as its representative to the Community Preservation Committee. Approval of the July 21, 2026 minutes was tabled to the next meeting.
decisions: Set a public hearing for Special Permit #206-26 at 4 Linden Ave for September 15, 2026, 4-0.
Nominated Michael Vigorito as Planning Board representative to the Community Preservation Committee, 3-0-1 with Vigorito abstaining.
Tabled approval of the July 21, 2026 minutes to the next meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion to set a Public Hearing for Special Permit #206-26 for September 15, 2026. Vigorito seconds. Motion carries unanimously (4-0).
Motion to nominate Michael Vigorito as Planning Board representative to the Community Preservation Committee. Lee seconds. Motion carries unanimously (3-0-1, Vigorito abstaned).
This item was tabled to the next meeting.
